methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine high-search travel and carry-on backpacks spanning premium, mid-range, and outdoor-crossover segments. Specs were gathered from manufacturer product pages (Peak Design, Nomatic, Osprey, Aer, Tortuga, Tom Bihn, Thule, Cotopaxi, Patagonia), major retail listings (REI, Amazon), and Pack Hacker's measured-review database to cross-check values. capacity_liters is the nominal marketed volume in liters; weight_lb is the manufacturer-stated empty weight in pounds; carry_on_compliant is a boolean reflecting whether the brand markets the bag as airline carry-on compatible (true) or not (false); warranty_years encodes lifetime warranties as 99 and confirmed limited-year warranties as the stated integer; dimensions_in follow H x W x D order in inches; laptop_size_in is the maximum laptop diagonal in inches that fits the dedicated sleeve (null if no dedicated sleeve). Prices are published US MSRP as of the research date. ADVERSARIAL RE-VERIFICATION (2026-06-15/18): all 9 products confirmed to exist; no fabrications. Three corrections applied: Tortuga Pro 40L price 349->375 (manufacturer page MSRP; Pack Hacker had listed 349), Patagonia Black Hole 32L price 149->179 (current patagonia.com MSRP; 149 was stale), Tom Bihn Aeronaut 45 weight 3.06->2.94 lb (manufacturer-stated for the named 630D ballistic version; Pack Hacker measured 3.06). accessedAt 2026-06-15.
